reason: Adds an integrated parallel side-chat panel to DeepSeek Harness with independent sessions, bounded parent-context access, and shared-workspace use.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加原生并行侧聊面板，支持独立会话、按需引用主会话上下文以及共享工作区。
summaries.en: Adds a native parallel side-chat panel to DeepSeek Harness with independent sessions, on-demand parent-context references, and shared workspace access.

capabilities: Creates and resumes independent side-chat sessions
Reads bounded, relevant excerpts from the parent conversation on demand
Shares the workspace with the main session
Allows native session tools, commands, file changes, attachments, and approval workflows
